summary: Honey-banded onyx in amber, orange and cream, glowing where light gets into the stone.
_comment: Polished onyx: honey-banded calcite onyx (the stone sold as onyx marble), cut and polished, its wavy amber, orange and cream bands glowing where light gets in. The maps are generated (L2, gen_onyx_polished.py): bands about 3 mm wide, each of fine laminae, with pale and faintly pink seams, undulating gently and irregularly (the scan's 15 cm waves cannot fit a 10 cm tile, and a regular wave repeats as a zigzag); the mean colour and roughness (0.04, polished) are anchored to the scan they replace. Re-made at its tag (2026-10-31, Phase19 D-9): it was ambientCG Onyx007 (CC0, tagged onyx and honey), judged 0.3 m, off its s01 tag, and that scan is one large wave structure no 0.1 m quilt can carry. The tile is exactly 0.1 m. SUBSURFACE: onyx's look is light scattering through it, more than marble's (backlit onyx panels glow through 2 cm). subsurface_color is ONE constant, the texture's mean linear albedo: the library cannot drive a textured article's scatter colour from its texture, so at subsurface_weight 0.5 the bands keep about half their contrast (a judgement between the glow and the banding). subsurface_radius 0.015 m (red), a judgement for a far clearer calcite than marble's 0.0085. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), water spots, gated by the Crevice mask. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Onyx_Polished_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: specular_ior 1.57, the mean of calcite's two indices (1.486, 1.658; onyx marble is banded calcite). subsurface_weight 0.5, subsurface_color the texture's mean linear albedo (0.573, 0.319, 0.147), subsurface_radius 0.015 m with a warm per-channel scale (1.0, 0.75, 0.45): onyx is far more translucent than marble (0.0085 m). The texture's mean linear albedo (0.573, 0.319, 0.147) and mean roughness 0.04 are those of ambientCG Onyx007 (CC0), the scan this set replaces. meters_per_tile 0.1 is the s01 scale option's length; the generator makes the tile at that size, bands about 3 mm wide as on the scan at its judged size, never stretched. Physically Based has no onyx or calcite entry.
